original_title: MotionViz - SIGGRAPH Appy Hour - Live Today!
original_content_full:
MotionViz - SIGGRAPH Appy Hour - Live Today!

The Appy Hour will go live today at 7 p.m. CET ! Join the presentation and Q&A follow up to learn more how MotionViz creates and adds stunning motion effects for videos. As a sneak peak you can already check out our presentation video here:
https://youtu.be/Zs6mCRCCQg0
